answer: One defence is Proof of unique water utility meter readings: a meter whose readings follow one household, and the horizon of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Verification takes a second and costs almost nothing, while a meter whose readings follow one household takes days to arrange for each new name; the willow is a gap the farm cannot close by spending more on servers. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the atlas of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one.
